label: Escape
description: Trapped, hunted, and running out of time.

beats.label: Trapped
beats.directive: Show where the protagonist is confined, why they must get out, and who or what holds them.

beats.label: The Plan
beats.directive: Find a way out and a means to use it; an ally or tool appears at a price.

beats.label: Breakout
beats.directive: The escape starts and goes wrong; the alarm is raised or the route is cut.

beats.label: Pursuit
beats.directive: The hunter closes in and reveals why they will never stop.

beats.label: The Threshold
beats.directive: One last barrier between the protagonist and freedom, with the hunter at their back. Choices are final, decisive moves.

beats.label: Freedom's Price
beats.directive: Show where the protagonist ends up and what was left behind; the outcome reflects the path taken. Offer no choices.
